title: Writing Task 2: Free Public Transport
source: IELTop original sample content, released with the app. Replace with licensed material.
prompt: Some people believe public transport should be free in large cities. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
tips: State your position clearly in the introduction.
Give two developed reasons with examples.
Use linking words to connect ideas.
Finish with a short conclusion that matches your position.
